column3: Web-client authoring rules: slot/props discipline (five derived shares, framework-made hooks only, stores as createXXXStore factories, no module-level singletons) and the build/dependency rules for packages/client/*.

Manifest with dual exports (host "." and "./client" with node+browser conditions), dsh.client declaration inject []/platform web/immediately true, zod+schemastery deps.
Per-heading hashes recording which English and Chinese README blocks are translation pairs.

Package reference: browser-host wire layer, browser auth + Host/Origin trust fence, connection generations, and the stated known limits (300 MiB buffered bodies, no logout, plain-HTTP cookie exposure).
Chinese translation of the connection package reference; same sections and limits.
One constant API_PATH='/api' shared by the node half and the browser half.
Browser-trust fence: assertTrustedAuthority (canonical bare host[:port] only), isRemoteAuthority, isTrustedApiRequest binding the Host header on every request including markerless ones.
BrowserAuth: launch-token exchange at /, HMAC-signed authority-bound cookies with issue/expiry checks, and the API-peer /connect cookie path.
Browser-safe re-export of the RPC envelope types plus the resultOf() unwrapper.
ConnectionController: generation source lifecycle, jittered exponential backoff capped at backoffMaxMs, separate readiness-warning and hard-deadline timers, and online/offline suspension.
Browser plugin entry: installConnection provides ctx.connection (generation, state, rpc, reconnect), reads __DSH_TRANSPORT__ and __DSH_CONNECTION_RECOVERY__, and emits connection/reset.
RFC 4122 v4 UUID built on crypto.getRandomValues so it works on insecure origins.
Browser unary RPC caller: JSON envelope POST, rpcId echo check, multipart binary-response parsing that restores bytes over null placeholders, and assertTarget's path-shape guard.
ConnectionWebSocket interface plus openConnectionWebSocket resolving the logical channel against the Host base (http→ws, https→wss).
CONNECT_PATH='/connect' and the ConnectionInteractions 'answer'|'none' union.

node:http ↔ WHATWG fetch bridge: client-disconnect abort hung off the response (not the request), declared-oversize 413 + destroy, buffered/streaming body modes, and backpressure-aware response writes.
Host plugin entry: Config schema, the /api prefix route and /connect exact route, assertImageBodyCapacity, and the connection/request waterfall.
Browser-safe isLoopbackHostname accepting localhost, [::1] and the whole 127/8 block.
Peer class: one admitted party with a fixed principal, its own cordis scope/Context and a lifetime AbortSignal.
Shared schemastery schema and resolver for backoff base/factor/max plus generationReadyWarnMs and generationReadyTimeoutMs, with a finite-factor check.
HostConnectionService: per-fibre channel registry, interceptors, exact fetch routes, peer admission, owner-only route enforcement, and multipart response writing with attachment metadata.
zod schemas for the client-request / server-response envelopes and the ok/error result union.
Carrier-neutral RPC contracts: branded RpcId, ok/error result union, attachment path/bytes types, ConnectionTrustRequest and the ClientConnectionRpc interface.
Contract-layer spec for transportError folding and resultOf unwrapping.
Trust-fence spec: markerless requests held to the Host check, loopback spellings, bind-IP matching, rebound Host refusal and Origin scheme normalisation.
Binary RPC spec: multipart roundtrip with and without gzip, attachment-table validation, and rejection of truncated or late bytes.
Browser-auth spec: token exchange, cookie authority binding, expiry rejection, and refusal of malformed/unsupported credential records.
Mutable credential-record double (RecordCredentials) plus provideBrowserCredentials for the auth specs.
Browser-half apply spec: bootstrap recovery validation, carrier selection, single-consumer loop ownership, RPC envelope validation and invalid-target rejection.
Connection lifecycle spec: ready publication, reconnect with a fresh generation, jittered cap retry, sink isolation and idempotent start().
Hand-pumped ConnectionGenerationSource double with suppressReady/holdReady and end/fail controls.
Exact fetch-route spec: dispatch and 404 for unclaimed paths, invalid/duplicate registration rejection, and 403 for non-owner peers.
Spec that the ready frame's Host facts publish and retract with the connection loop.
Bridge spec: oversize rejection destroys the request, disconnect aborts the carrier signal, and multipart responses finish without further writes after a client close.
Spec pinning the accepted loopback hostnames and the refused malformed ones.
Node-half spec: /api route registration, trust+auth admission, owner-peer dispatch, exact-route withdrawal and per-method status codes.
Spec pinning the recovery defaults and rejecting timing that could disable recovery or overflow a timer.
Spec for the RPC envelope schemas, the failure shape and RpcId branding.
Spec for WebSocket base resolution (explicit base, document base) and the refusal to open without a base outside a document.

Host project: node-side file list including the trust fence, browser-auth, http-bridge and rpc-host, with webserver/scope references.
Solution tsconfig referencing the host and client projects.

Per-heading translation-pair hashes for the file-upload README.
Package reference: Session-addressed uploads, streaming intake, progress, cancellation, staged receipts, and the limits (not resumable, one-shot streams, no stream total, self-contained Worker).
Chinese translation of the file-upload package reference.
Browser contract types: FileUploadBody (Blob | ReadableStream), FileUploadProgress and the FileUploadService upload() signature.
Browser plugin entry: provides ctx.fileUpload via the FileUploadRuntime service; injects the generated remote.
Background upload implementation: the self-contained Worker body (XHR for Blob progress, fetch for streams), the page-owned __DSH_FILE_UPLOAD__ hook, and strict receipt validation.
Authenticated raw-byte upload route: POST + application/octet-stream + sessionId required, streaming body chunks, and JSON business/internal failure envelope.
Host service: the streaming route registration, the command file-receipt resolver, the Session-keyed staged-receipt table, and the PromptFileBinding disposable-transaction guard.
FILE_UPLOAD_PATH='/api/session/uploadFileBinary' and its document-relative form.
Encoded upload request, FileUploadValue/ReceiptId types and the page-owned FileUploadFetch hook types.
Spec for the upload route: method/media-type/sessionId rejection before any storage, chunk delivery, and business vs internal error envelopes.
Spec for the Worker body (credentials, progress, completion/failure), stream transfer, and the receipt validation and page-hook behaviour of the service.

Package reference: live graph sync, rebuild-driven reload, the browser swap, cascade/self-reload and the failure policy (no rollback, React state lost).
Chinese translation of the hmr package reference.

Browser transport: reads the events route through the page's __DSH_TRANSPORT__.fetch when present, otherwise EventSource; drops malformed frames with a warning and delegates graph/rebuilt frames to the entry controller.
Shared SSE frame types (graph | rebuilt), the parse result that separates unknown types from malformed frames, and the EVENTS_ENDPOINT constant.
Host half: one stat-poll over each graph row's bundle, mtime/ctime/size revision tracking, clientModules.rebuilt reporting, and the /plugins/events SSE channel.
Spec for the frame parser: complete frames accepted, unknown types separated from malformed known frames.
Spec for the Node half: bundle watches follow the graph, stat changes report rebuilt, and the SSE channel's per-connection graph plus teardown.
Spec for the browser transport: forwards graph/rebuilt frames, contains wire errors, closes the EventSource, and reads through the page transport when one exists.

Per-heading translation-pair hashes for the locale README.
Package reference: zh/en preference, browser-derived fallback, typed namespace dictionaries, the framework translation seat, and the limit that registry-held text reads its translation once.
Chinese translation of the locale package reference.
Native-shell bootstrap contract and parseLocaleBootstrap, which validates the untrusted preload IPC response before any field is read.

LocaleRuntime: the dictionary registry, the per-key fallback chain (active → declared fallbacks → common → the key itself), stable per-namespace bind identity, publish() that bumps the revision but only emits locale/change on an active switch, and the Language row registration.
Styles for the settings Language row: 16px vertical padding, hairline separator, 36px control height, theme tokens only.
Language preference row component: reads active/options from the store, renders a Menu of self-described labels, and writes through the injected setLocale.
Language row store: a mirror of the locale snapshot with a revision guard that drops stale and duplicate syncs.
Ambient declaration for *.module.css class maps and plain *.css.
Host half: registers the locale settings namespace with a volatile preference field, hidden from the generated settings pages.
Durable locale preference schema: BCP 47-style id pattern, the preference field name, and the built-in locale ids.
English common-namespace dictionary, checked complete against the zh key set by the satisfies clause.
Re-export point documenting zh as the key-set source of truth and en as checked against it.
settings.locale namespace dictionary (language.title) with the same zh-source-of-truth convention.
Chinese common-namespace dictionary and the CommonKey union derived from its keys.
Spec for the plugin wiring: service+dictionary provisioning, declaration-aware Language row registration, snapshot projection, and recovery after an HMR collapse of the declaring entry.
Spec that a failed native read is reported, an automatic choice is never persisted, and a stored external locale waits for its language to register.
Spec that the Host settings lifecycle accepts a valid locale preference and rejects malformed ones.
Spec that <html lang> tracks the resolved locale with BCP 47 tags and is not rewritten for dictionary-only changes.
Component spec for the Language row: label rendering, menu open/select/close, outside-pointerdown close, and store-driven label changes.

Spec for LocaleRuntime: the active→en→key chain, the common-namespace fallthrough, parameter interpolation, stable bind identity, language-pack registration, recursive fallback chains, cycle rejection and the two shipped locales.
Spec for resolveText: literal strings pass through, translation maps resolve per locale with lowercase keys and follow registered regional fallbacks.
Spec for the Language row store: init shape, mirror sync, and the revision guard dropping stale writes.

Per-heading translation-pair hashes for the modules README.

Package reference: the lazy-CJS model, incremental composition, boot-manifest injection, entry ownership, host release changes, and the stated limits (metadata revisions, flat module graph, release detection rides the graph stream).
Chinese translation of the modules package reference.
ClientEntries: page-owned Loader entry reconciliation, the serialised queue, generation guards against stale downloads, code replacement, and the failure list published to page diagnostics.
tearDownEntryFiber (registry deletion + inertia drain before clearing the fiber) and removeOwnedStyles by data-plugin attribute.
Browser half entry: createClientModuleSystem from the HTML facade, the bootstrap export, and the plugin face that publishes the Loader's internal module system as ctx.modules.
Browser-safe contract: the __DSH_BOOT__ wire types, the lazy-CJS resolution branch order, the boot-manifest parser, the dsh.client declaration parser and the module-table interfaces.
notifySubscribers: copies the listener set and contains one throwing subscriber so the rest still run.
ReleaseChangeGate: the page applies graphs and rebuilt frames only while the Host serves the release the page booted from, announces the change, and can dismiss it.
ClientModuleSystem: default bundle loader, revision rewriting of bundle URLs, chunk resolution, style claiming by data-plugin, the load/materialize/invalidate machinery and the loadCache.

Host half: ClientModuleRegistry — incremental per-package scan of Loader entries (no full-rescan path), combo script and source-map construction, the 3 KiB URL partition, the /plugins route, the index injection rows and the graph/rebuilt notifications.
Spec for page entry reconciliation: add/remove/re-enable, style ownership, obsolete-generation rejection, bootstrap ownership, retained failed entries for retry, and the release-change announcements.

Spec for the module table: batch arrival failure with a single-resource fallback, partial registration never re-executed, chunk arrival and invalidation, boot manifest validation, and loud failures for cycles/duplicates/double boot.

Spec for the Node half: package metadata resolution across Loader resolver versions, duplicate-source refusal and recovery, revision derivation from metadata, the 3 KiB combo partition, and source-map serving.

Per-heading translation-pair hashes for the product-analytics README.

Package reference: the field table, the identity reuse, the one-shot environment sampling, and the limits (one-shot sampling, blocked PowerShell queries, disabling does not clear the exporter queue, best-effort delivery).
Chinese translation of the product-analytics README, including the detailed per-event counting rules.
Renderer sender: only collects when the dshDesktop global is present, follows the Host policy over a reconnecting stream, fails closed on stream loss, and discards transport failures.

Bounded, cancellable execFile metadata query with no shell, a maxBuffer cap, a timeout, and fixed failure reasons (unavailable/invalid-value/query-failed/timeout/output-limit/unsupported) that never leak raw output.
collectEnvironment: approved scalar fields only, with independent per-source failure isolation, zod validation of the OS command output, and missing_fields carrying reasons instead of zero values.
ProductEventMap: the event catalogue with the exact attribute shape each event may carry, plus OnboardingPage and TrackProductEvent.

Host service: the enabled()/watchPolicy() RPCs, the cached environment snapshot shared across concurrent intakes, the fresh identity read per event, the compaction-start event, and the enabled check before and after the awaits.
Spec for the renderer side: never collects in Web, drops disabled events with no backfill, no retry on transport rejection, survives a synchronous Remote failure, and fails closed on stream loss.

Spec for the Host side: disabled collection reads no identity, approved fields only, missing identity keeps the event, unload suppresses late results, one environment query shared across events, and the sorted missing_fields encoding.
End-to-end spec booting the shipped profile against a local OTLP receiver and asserting the captured record carries the real system fields and no forbidden ones.
Spec for the query helper: UTF-8 capture, no raw error text, timeout termination, output-limit bounding on both streams, abort handling and synchronous spawn isolation.
Spec for collectEnvironment: Windows revision handling, invalid JSON rejection, physical-core summation, native-vs-app architecture, macOS security-suffix handling and per-field failure isolation.
Fixture booting the production profile with an isolated OTLP receiver and computing the reference values from the OS itself.
Loader overlay disabling unrelated plugins and enabling the telemetry exporter and product analytics with a synthetic release version.

Host project listing the service, events, environment and environment-query with telemetry/credentials/session/compaction/settings references.

Per-heading translation-pair hashes for the resources README.
Package reference: the dsh-resource:// address scheme, provider registration, pinning, and the lifecycle/failure rules (records kept for the page lifetime, failures are frames).
Chinese translation of the resources package reference.
The published resource model: ResourceSnapshot, UseResource typed by the declaration-merged ResourceProtocolMap, the provider contract, and the Resources service.
Browser plugin: provides ctx.resources and contributes the resource root keyed hook so every slot component receives useResource.

ResourceRegistry: per-address records kept for the page lifetime so source() stays reference-stable, holder counting over subscribers and pins, protocolOf() scheme parsing, and frame-driven failure handling.
Pure host half: apply() is a no-op because the resource model lives in the browser export.
Spec that ctx.resources is provided, useResource reaches root and session scopes, and both leave with the fiber so a reload registers cleanly again.
Spec for the resource lifecycle: open on first holder, share across holders, reopen as a fresh stream, pin semantics, late frames dropped, and provider disposal.
Single client tsconfig including src with references to cordis/typert/store/ui-renderer/ui-slots.
clientBundle(..., ['lib/types/index.js']) for the resources package.

Manifest exposing a separate ./protocol entry; dsh.client injects the locale package.
Per-heading translation-pair hashes for the shortcuts README.
Package reference: per-device command defaults, overrides-only persistence, chord bindings, the fixed-action reservation model, and the platform restrictions per runtime.
Chinese translation of the shortcuts package reference.

Physical-key protocol: normalizeBinding (primary expansion, code validation, canonical modifier order), bindingKey, presentBinding for keycaps/ARIA, and the per-platform isWebBindingAllowed admission.
Keyboard adapter: region detection, composition/dead-key/AltGraph guards, a MutationObserver for modal changes, the capture-phase reset of pending sequences, and the terminal Ctrl+W/R pass-through.

ShortcutsService: environment detection, web vs Desktop storage selection, the native keyboard bridge requirement, the publish gate on sequence ordering, and the public edit/describeBinding/recording/closeWindow faces.
installNativeKeyboard: routes native menu/keyboard/iframe/webview input through the same registry, rejecting stale revisions and verifying frame identity and embedding ownership before dispatch.

ShortcutRegistry: command and fixed-command registration, the derived catalog, and dispatch arbitration (region, modal, conflict and priority) that blocks a conflicting binding instead of disabling it.
webShortcutStorage over localStorage with a same-origin storage-event listener, and desktopShortcutStorage reading the restricted preload capability.
Command contribution types: ShortcutContext, ShortcutCommand, ShortcutGesture, the fixed-command shape and the public Shortcuts service interface.
Host Config with stopSequenceMs (default 500) bounded below the browser timer limit.
Preference document validation, effective-shortcut resolution, the edit operations and the conflict/issue classification including platform-specific binding admission.
Host plugin: injects the validated keyboard timing into served pages as __DSH_SHORTCUTS_CONFIG__.
DesktopShortcutInput union (menu | keyboard | iframe | webview) carrying the accepted revision, and the DesktopKeyboardApi preload contract.

ShortcutPersistence: a single-writer queue, revision-checked edits classified as saved/stale/unreadable/write-failed/not-ready/conflict, and the rule that a write failure keeps the previous document and draft.
Barrel re-exporting binding, configuration, persistence and native for the shared ./protocol entry.
Spec for the Host timing config and the index injection row.
Spec for document validation and conflict resolution: inherited/cleared/reset/dormant preferences, invalid document retention, future-version refusal, edit and definition parsing.
Spec for two-key chords: overlapping default rejection at registration and IPC ingress, canonicalisation, schema v1→v2 migration on write, and conflicts against fixed reservations.

Spec for the DOM adapter: native input ownership on Desktop, the macOS Option+Command+N dead-key case, composition/229/AltGraph/dead-key protection, modal blocking, terminal ownership and target resolution.
Spec for fixed actions: local consumption ordering, sequence reset on focus/pointer/blur/modal change, disposal cleanup, reservation publication, and observer failure containment.
Spec for native input: revision checks, repeats, frame-identity verification for iframes and webviews, shadow focus, and unbound menu invocation.

Spec for the persistence coordinator: publish-once after durable completion, stale rejection, write-failure retention, unreadable documents blocking edits, reread-before-write and post-disposal suppression.
Spec for the registry: Web admission rules, terminal Ctrl+W/R pass-through, conflict blocking, dormant-override conflicts and identical priority before/after a save.
Spec for the service: Desktop window close with the current revision, conflict description, Web persistence, fixed reservation publication and catalog publication failure propagation.
Spec for localStorage: same-origin updates, stale draft rejection, quota failure retention and refusal to replace future data.

Package library note: synchronous and frame-driven publication, immer updates, shallow equality, optional browser persistence, and the localStorage-only persistence limit.
Chinese translation of the store package note.
Framework-neutral contracts: ObservableSnapshot, the selector hook shapes, the ActionsDecl/BakedActions write-set discipline, StoreSpec and the StoreHandle/StoreFactory split.

The engine: createSnapshotStore over zustand vanilla + immer with sync/raf flush, opt-in localStorage persistence and dev freeze, plus defineStore baking an init/persist/actions literal into a handle whose create(scopeKey) suffixes the persist key.

Spec for the engine: draft updates preserving untouched branches, sync vs raf notification, rAF fallback, freeze semantics, rehydration and persistence failures, per-scope persist keys and shallowEqual.
Single client tsconfig including src with the cordis reference.
staticLinked(...) putting the store on the static assembly channel instead of the module table.

Shared build preset: the clientBundle/staticLinked presets, the bundle purity gate that makes a cross-plugin value import a build error, the CSS-modules and image inlining plugins, the async chunk require rewrite, the tsc source-map chaining and the build-face selection.

Package reference: the draft rail, message images and lightbox, the drop overlay, and the limits (no zoom/download, the lightbox does not trap focus).
Chinese translation of the ui-attachment package reference.
Styles for the horizontal rail: hidden scrollbar, 64px items, absolutely positioned edge arrows, hover/focus and coarse-pointer reveal of the remove control.

Horizontal overflow rail: edge arrows recomputed from scroll geometry on scroll, item-count change and a ResizeObserver on the rail element, vertical-wheel-to-horizontal translation with a per-tick clamp, and growth-only auto-reveal.
Styles for the composer rail, the 64px image thumbnail and the coarse-pointer-visible remove control.
Composer assembly: drop overlay, the mixed image/file rail, the upload state mapping to the FileCard states, and the local preview lightbox.
installDocumentDropEvents: file-only drag detection, a nested drag-depth counter, the viewport-leave reset, and directory detection through the entry API.
Browser plugin: registers the conversation.images.content Factory and injects the composer attachment entry plus the four image positions at priority 100.
Label resolvers mapping the conversation namespace onto the rail, overlay, file card and message image components.
MessageImagesContent Factory and the MessageImages slot adapter that renders through renderFactorySlot.
Ambient declaration for *.module.css class maps and plain *.css.
Styles for the full-viewport drop mask: pointer-events none so drag targeting survives, blur backdrop, fade-in and its reduced-motion opt-out.
Pointer-inert drop invitation rendered through a body portal, with the enabled and disabled SVG illustrations.
Styles for the pending-file card: 240×64 layout, the spinner, the indeterminate progress bar animation and the error state colours.
Pending-file card: type glyph or spinner, the name and extension/size meta line, a separate retry affordance on failure, remove, and the byte progress bar.
Host half: apply() is a no-op because the client half registers the React slot entries.
Styles for the gallery: wrap flow with per-align rules, the 64px tile and 48px thumbnail variants, the failed-load box that keeps the grid cell, and focus rings.

MessageImage and ImageGallery: the singleFit sizing rule (240px long edge, aspect clamped to [0.25,4], never upscaled, crop anchor toward the informative edge), the peek/load split, the retry control, and the lightbox.
Spec for the rail: owner cards in order, edge arrows from scroll geometry, ResizeObserver on the rail element, wheel translation with clamped travel, reduced-motion paging and growth-only reveal.
Spec for the composer: file drops accepted anywhere, non-file drags left native, directory reporting through the entry API, nested drag tracking, blocked drops, and the file card states.
Spec for the overlay: body portal, optional desc line, and the illustration swap when disabled.
Spec proving a domain override replaces only its own image position and that the shared gallery returns on disposal.

Spec for the image component: cached first frame, bounded single fit and crop anchors, the fixed tile size, thumbnail status icons with localized labels, late-settling loads ignored, and the preview arm that bypasses the loader.
Spec that the host half stays inert and that every entry and the Factory leave with the plugin fiber.
Single client tsconfig including src with references to cordis/attachment and the five UI packages plus locale.
